entities.name: Ivo Tartaglia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Dr. Ivo Tartaglia was "a committed anti-fascist",
a former ban (governor) of the province of Littoral Banovina, and the 32nd mayor of Split, Yugoslavia.
